test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

CARS : HFWX :: BOAT: GTFY :: FUSE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**CARS: HFWX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cb3e5431271c0d915a1cc0c7099f6c4d131e4ffd3e8e7c649a49bf3ebc45ccb.png] 

**BOAT: GTFY**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea518bf89e1a959dc1a8abef4e3a5e1b580352dc84e603d5c453b93d46e63364.png] 

Similarly,

**FUSE: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fdfb7bf54e9e4e8f84ddb5ea6cd3bfcd23f81b4e2e6aa6e448a4e80eaef869d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"KZXJ"**.
